source.note: Kenney boat-speed-c (GLB with the kit colormap), same kit and fetch pin as boat-fishing and boat-sail; picked from the kit's ten speed boats (a-j) as the clearest runabout silhouette: pointed bow, raked windscreen, tow arch aft. Kit scale kept (about 1.65 m per source unit, as the other watercraft): height 2.15 m keel to arch top gives a 5.24 m hull and 2.95 m beam (chunky toy proportions, beam on the wide side). Bow toward +Z (image-left in the lab left view). y = 0 is the hull bottom; the waterline sits at about y = 0.4 m (just above the lower chine), so a film sinks the boat 0.4 m into its water plane. Red topsides and bottom (the source's red deck and dark-grey bottom both go to trim, lit down to -0.6 so the flanks stay red and only the shadow-side bow and transom take the brown shade), cream rub-stripe band, cockpit and console, dark-brown tow arch and windscreen. Static, no clips.
